feat(hybrid-cloud): Implement auth proxy for GitHub (#48952)

This PR adds the IntegrationProxyClient for the GitHub integration. Some
things to note:
- This will also affect GItHub Enterprise since they share the client
mixin
- This will not affect the legacy plugin. I've changed the names of
those classes to make it clear they aren't the same.
- The `create_token`, `get_token` and `request` method have all been
removed from the client mixin, with all callsites removed (since token
methods should not be called on clients initialized on region silos).
There was only one instance of `force_refresh=True` which I've also
removed.
- Since GitHub is invoked from the installation object, there was only
one call site to update.
- There are two auth schemes for GitHub, JWTs and Access Tokens. We use
access tokens for github data that isn't pertaining to the installation
itself. For installation metadata, or refreshing access tokens, we use
JWTs. In code, I've specified this as endpoints starting with
`/app/installations

**todo**
- [x] Add tests for new authorization code
- [x] E2E testing locally with region silo (once cyclic imports are
resolved)
